title: Students Referred to Authorities for Vaping in Last Five Years
what_it_is: Students Referred to Authorities for Vaping in Last Five Years

sections.label: School vaping checks and education
sections.summary: Schools and IHLs stepped up checks and preventive education on vaping, with about 800 students referred to HSA in 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Our schools and IHLs have stepped up checks in recent years and the number of students referred to HSA increased to about 800 in 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Education (MOE), Ministry of Health (MOH), HSA and the Health Promotion Board (HPB) are concerned about the vaping situation not just among students, but in the wider community.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOE is working with MOH, HSA and HPB to strengthen detection, enforcement and education.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Besides enforcement checks, our schools and IHLs have stepped up preventive education to convey the harmful effects of vaping on one's health.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Can I ask if there are plans to allocate more resources, be it technology, teaching tools or maybe even manpower, to assist our schools in addressing the issue of vaping among our youths?

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: Certainly, where necessary, we will allocate the necessary resources to improve our effort at reaching out to the students.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: We imbue the messages against smoking and vaping in our curriculum.

sections.label: Science and citizenship curriculum lessons
sections.summary: Science lessons cover harmful substances and their consequences, while Character and Citizenship Education teaches addictive behaviours and peer influence.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: In the Science curriculum in education, we also explain to the students the harmful effects of substances found in products as well as the consequences on individuals, families and society are discussed at the lower secondary level.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: In our Character and Citizenship Education, the students also learn about recognising impulsive and addictive behaviours that harm one's mental health, physical well-being and how to manage the concept of self-esteem as well as management of negative peer influence.
